## Summary

Describe the user problem and the change. Link the related issue or reviewed design.

## Verification

List commands and results for affected tests, types, lint and builds. Link prior
integration evidence when it applies; state failed, skipped or unconfigured
checks explicitly. For critical admission, race or erasure guards, include the
scope and evidence required by CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/mutation-testing.md.

## User-visible changes

Describe setup, recovery or workflow changes and any relevant guide updates.
For UI changes, include screenshots and keyboard/mobile verification where
applicable. Use synthetic content and remove credentials from evidence.

## Migration and release impact

Describe database changes, compatibility, deployment requirements and known
limitations. Include independent migration review when migrations change.
Do not claim an unperformed release, provider test or hosted payment acceptance.
